question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a pink present, Bob has a yellow present, Claire has a purple present, Dave has a black present, Eve has a green present, Fred has a gold present, and Gertrude has a silver present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Eve and Gertrude swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) pink present
(B) yellow present
(C) purple present
(D) black present
(E) green present
(F) gold present
(G) silver present
solution:
Present colors in Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude order:
Initial: pink, yellow, purple, black, green, gold, silver
After Claire–Gertrude: pink, yellow, silver, black, green, gold, purple
After Gertrude–Alice: purple, yellow, silver, black, green, gold, pink
After Gertrude–Fred: purple, yellow, silver, black, green, pink, gold
After Claire–Alice: silver, yellow, purple, black, green, pink, gold
After Eve–Fred: silver, yellow, purple, black, pink, green, gold
After Dave–Claire: silver, yellow, black, purple, pink, green, gold
After Eve–Gertrude: silver, yellow, black, purple, gold, green, pink
Alice has the silver present, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
